{{Quote|Welcome to Var'soonta's Many Treasures. Do you know the Black Death who slaughters my people?|Imot|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Varsoonta's Many Treasures''' was a small salvage business run by [[Var'soonta]] in the village of [[Voam]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Varsoonta was assisted by the [[Evocii]] [[Imot]].
